# Inflation index (`inflation-index` v1)

Published CPI fixings (US CPI-U NSA, HICPxT, UK RPI…).

**Group:** Market data · **Mnemonic:** `INF` · **Identifiers:** `INF-…` in `indexId`

Open one with `INF <id>`.

```sutra
sutra: inflation-index
version: 1
description: "Published CPI fixings (US CPI-U NSA, HICPxT, UK RPI…)."
match: { kind: inflation-index, priority: 10 }
title: { pill: Market data · Inflation index, id: $.indexId }
strip:
  - { label: Name, bind: $.name }
  - { label: Latest, bind: $.latest, fmt: price2, emphasis: true }
  - { label: YoY, bind: $.yoy, fmt: pct2, tone: sign }
  - { label: Publication lag, bind: $.lag }
panels:
  - id: fixings
    kind: ladder
    title: Monthly fixings
    key: F2
    rows: $.fixings
    columns:
      - { label: Month, bind: "@.month" }
      - { label: Index, bind: "@.value", fmt: price2 }
      - { label: YoY, bind: "@.yoy", fmt: pct2, tone: sign }
  - { id: built, kind: provenance, title: How this view was built }
  - { id: refs, kind: links, title: Linked entities, code: REFS, area: right }
keys: { F7: "link($.inflationCurve, 'inflation-curve')", F8: impact, F9: raw }
```
